items.html: And know that from this Garon is the beginning of the making of the existence of ZA, in the phase of three included within three alone, and this is the secret that we explained above. For from the Yesod of Arich, which is called Shofar, ZA came out in the phase of voice, which includes fire, water and wind, which are three; and it is known that the Shofar, too, is in the Garon.
